levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Persona lacks a name, an explicit age of eighteen or older, or any invented circumstance.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Persona has an invented name, a stated age of eighteen or older, and at least one sentence of invented circumstance.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the invented circumstance includes a specific, plausible detail (type of home, job type) rather than a generic phrase.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more weeks are missing a block category, or every week is identical with no variation.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All weeks include all four block categories, and at least one week is noticeably varied from the others.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the written explanation for the varied week names a specific, plausible real-life cause.

lookFors: No real names, addresses, or the learner's own identifying details appear anywhere on the persona sheet.
The persona's age is stated explicitly as eighteen or older.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
